title: HTTP 502 caused by unavailable backend
symptoms: Gateway returns 502 and backend health check fails
cause: Backend service was not available on its configured port
resolution: The operations team verified the service status and configuration, then restored the backend using the approved procedure

title: Slow application due to database pool saturation
symptoms: Requests are slow and database connections are frequently unavailable
resolution: The team inspected query duration and pool configuration before applying an approved capacity adjustment
